abstract.text: A Project keeps your places together. An Activity plans one round of work using those places.

inlineContent.text: Choose a Project to see its places. The iOS app also lets you select an Activity and optional Assignment to focus a round of work. The web map lets you explore the Projects and Locations available to your account.
Build the Project map before planning a Route. When you are ready to work, create an Activity with a Route and Assignments in the iOS app. The same Project and its Locations can be viewed on the web.

abstract.text: Learn how LinkMap organizes shared places and work, use the iOS and web apps, and understand the implementation behind them.
Follow one Project from a first place to a planned visit.
LinkMap centers on a Project: a shared map and a collection of Activities. Places remain available across Activities, so a team can plan another round of work without recreating its map.
